dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Isolated chronic progressive external ophthalmoplegia due to a mitochondrial myopathy, most likely a pathogenic mitochondrial DNA deletion

ALTERNATIVE: Ocular myasthenia gravis

ALTERNATIVE: Congenital fibrosis of the extraocular muscles due to a KIF21A or related developmental motor-neuron disorder

ALTERNATIVE: Functional neurological disorder presenting as episodic ophthalmoplegia
